stories.title: Consent API Endpoints for Tier Capture and Retrieval
stories.description: Implement FastAPI endpoints to capture user consent tier (Tier 1 vs Tier 2), retrieve current consent status by session, and expose audit metadata for downstream services.

stories.title: Frontend Consent Prompt and Tier Selection Handling
stories.description: Add UI interaction pattern in chat flow to present consent options, capture user selection, and persist via backend API while maintaining conversational continuity.

stories.title: De-identification Pipeline Enforcement Hook
stories.description: Implement a reusable hook within consent service to enforce HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification prior to any storage when Tier 1 is selected, ensuring consistency across all entry points.

stories.title: Cross-Service Consent Contract Integration (Lead + Unknown প্রশ্ন)
stories.description: Standardize and enforce consent contract usage across lead capture and unknown question services to ensure consistent handling of identifiable vs de-identified data.
